_comment: 3rd mockup variant (hybrid-desktop-phones) — CORRECTED per Eric's feedback. The first attempt put all 3 devices on screen at once in a new composite animation. Eric's intent: COMPOSE the two existing templates as the two states of one reveal — state 1 = a set of 2 phones (dual-phone template, static), state 2 = 1 desktop (desktop-browser template, static), yPercent reveals state 2. 3 screenshots total (2 phone + 1 desktop), not 6. Text-only Playwright, 1600x1000 + 375x812.
composition: state1 = 2 PhoneFrames (dual-phone template, static, 1 screen each, phone2 staggered); state2 = 1 StaticDesktop (desktop-browser frame template, static, 1 screen). Both reuse the existing templates — no new composite animation.
axisLogic: unchanged in App.jsx: axis = type==='desktop-browser' ? 'xPercent' : 'yPercent'. hybrid is not desktop-browser -> yPercent. No App.jsx edit.
reveal: single .mockup-inner-N element is a 2-state container (md:h-[200%], 2 cells md:h-1/2 each). yPercent:-50 scrolls exactly one state height (600px at md:h-[600px] stage) -> state 1 (phones, top) scrolls out, state 2 (desktop, bottom) scrolls in. Same reveal mechanism as dual-phone.
screenshotCount: 3 total: phones[0] + phones[1] (state 1) + desktop (state 2). Graceful: if {src,alt} present, else branded placeholder ({label,emoji,labelClass}). Ships with placeholders; adding src swaps to real screenshot (data-only).
responsive: 2-state reveal runs on md+ only (stage ~580-700px there, 2 phones fit natively at 504px, overflow-hidden clips only the off-screen state). On mobile the stage is too narrow for 2 phones side by side, so mobile shows the 2 phones statically (exactly like dual-phone mobile); the md+ reveal element is display:none so GSAP's yPercent is harmless.

t0_state1_phones.phone2: top80 bottom600 visible (staggered, reaches stage bottom exactly via md:pb-16 — no clip)

desktop_1600x1000.note: md:pb-16 lifts the phone pair 64px so the staggered phone2 (md:translate-y-16) reaches the state bottom exactly — without it, the stage overflow-hidden (required for the reveal) clipped phone2's lower 64px.

mobile_375x812.innerDisplay: none (md+ reveal element hidden on mobile -> GSAP yPercent harmless, innerTy none)
mobile_375x812.layout: 2 phones side by side statically, no desktop, no overflow — matches dual-phone mobile

result: PASS — corrected to compose the 2 existing templates as 2 states of one yPercent reveal. State 1 = 2 phones, state 2 = 1 desktop. 3 screenshots. Per-slide feel intact (1.5-unit yPercent reveal, pin 15000 unchanged). Mobile degrades to static 2 phones. Ready for Eric's 3 screenshots (2 phone + 1 desktop).
